Cedric Blackthorn stood tall and confident in the elegant ballroom, his emerald-green eyes scanning the crowd for new faces. Spotting an interesting first-time aristocrat, Cedric's lips curled into an inviting smile. With a graceful stride, he approached the other noble, extending a hand in greeting.

"Good evening," Cedric greeted warmly, his voice carrying a hint of charm and charisma. "I couldn't help but notice your refined presence from across the room. I am Cedric Blackthorn. It's a pleasure to make your acquaintance."

His tone was friendly yet tinged with curiosity as he awaited the response from his newfound counterpart. Cedric's face radiated genuine interest as he observed the other aristocrat's reaction to his introduction. His lively green eyes shone with an unspoken invitation to engage in conversation.
